## Problem and resulting behavior

Explain the user-visible change. Use synthetic examples only.

## Validation

List the commands run and actual results. Distinguish offline/mocked tests from live integrations.

## Permissions and privacy

Describe changed tool permissions, external destinations, stored fields or retention behavior. Write “unchanged” when appropriate.

- [ ] I checked the diff for credentials, private files, runtime state and customer data.
- [ ] Tests cover changed boundary behavior and relevant failure cases.
- [ ] Documentation and claims match the behavior tested.

For exploitable vulnerabilities, coordinate through private Security Advisories before opening a public PR.
